name: gesture
description: Gestures made with a finger or the mouse, turned into actions: a swipe in one of four directions raises the action of that direction. It reads the pointer (the actions that carry its position and its press, as a menu does), so the same game works with a mouse and with a touch screen. Menus you scroll, a thing you throw, a board you slide, pages you turn.

components.name: Swipe
components.description: Watches the pointer: when the press action goes down it notes where, and when it goes up, if the pointer moved at least min_distance pixels in at most max_ticks ticks (0 for no limit), it raises the action of the direction it moved in: the axis with the bigger movement counts (y grows downwards, so a swipe towards the bottom of the screen is down). A direction whose action is none raises nothing, and a movement that is too short or too slow is not a swipe (a tap, a click, a drag). pointer_x and pointer_y are the actions that carry the position in pixels. A Disabled Swipe does nothing and forgets a swipe in progress. active, start_x, start_y and elapsed are its own state.

systems.name: detect
systems.description: Follows the press of every Swipe and raises the action of the direction of the ones that just ended with a swipe.
